data.text:
World’s largest illegal sports streaming platform — Streameast- has been shut down after a year long investigation.

It had 80 unauthorised domains and generated 1.6billion combined visits over the past year providing free access to global sports fixtures, including Europe’s top football leagues like the PL. 

Traffic to the site reached 136million average monthly visits, with domains primarily originating from the U.S., Canada, the United Kingdom, the Philippines and Germany.

In addition to confiscating cash and multiple credit cards, investigators also uncovered links to a shell company in the UAE allegedly used to launder advertising revenue totalling £4.9million ($6.2m) since 2010, plus a further £150,000 ($200,000) in crypto currency.

In 2024, Lebron was seen watching an NBA game courtside on Streameast.

Streameast’s original domain is no longer active, however, back-up domains — or those purporting to be replacement services — are now up and running.

-The Athletic

TRAFFIC ADVISORY - UPDATE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

03 September 2025

FATAL ACCIDENT SCENE CLEARED, N1 NORTH REOPENED; 

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) can confirm that the scene of the fatal accident on the N1 North freeway, between the Buccleuch Interchange and Allandale Road, has now been fully cleared. All lanes of the freeway have been reopened to traffic.

While the physical obstruction has been removed, motorists should still expect traffic delays as the severe backlog from the earlier disruption begins to ease. We urge all road users to exercise extreme patience and caution in the area.

The JMPD further confirms the tragic loss of five lives in the single-vehicle accident involving an overturned minibus taxi.

A case of culpable homicide will be opened for further investigation into the cause of the accident.

Our thoughts are with the families of the deceased and the injured. We thank the public for their continued cooperation.

-END-

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic #SaferJoburg 

Commissioner @Jaca_Patrick on the ground ensuring that the freeway is clear and safe. #JMPDInAction

Traffic Advisory
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

03 September 2025

FATAL ACCIDENT ON N1 NORTH FREEWAY: MOTORISTS ADVISED TO USE ALTERNATIVE ROUTES 

The Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department (JMPD) advises motorists of a major traffic disruption on the N1 North freeway following a fatal accident.

A single-vehicle accident involving an overturned minibus taxi has occurred on the N1 North between the Buccleuch Interchange and Allandale Road in Midrand.

Emergency services and law enforcement officials are currently on the scene. The accident has resulted in multiple injuries and tragically, five confirmed fatalities.

The far-right lane is currently affected, and traffic is severely backed up. A full closure of the freeway will be necessary shortly to allow for the proper processing of the scene and recovery operations.

Motorists can expect heavy delays in both directions on the N1 freeway. The JMPD strongly advises all road users to avoid this section of the freeway and to seek alternative routes.

Motorists are urged to exercise patience and to drive with caution.

-END-

Issued by the Johannesburg Metropolitan Police Department Communication Unit #JoburgRoadSafety #JHBTraffic #NomakanjaniManjeNamhlanje #SaferJoburg
